node.title: The syzygy-circuit branch: bound the full-support minimal-circuit exceptions
node.statement: E13's 71 non-AG exceptions are ALL one-dimensional full-locator-support syzygy circuits, and the PROVED circuit lemma (row dependencies = exactly two zero-polynomial identities; one-dim full-support dependencies with independent deletions are minimal circuits) makes the branch precise: count/classify minimal full-support circuits per (n, j) and price their slope contribution. The exception taxonomy's third and final observed branch.
node.notes: a precise algebraic proof target per the packet's own framing; the circuit lemma is its proved base | FLIP on replay (Codex rednode wave 2): TARGET -> CONDITIONAL; packet in nodes/spread_syzygy_circuit_bound/.
node.attack_surface: DECOMPOSED: nongenericity (degree counting on the two simultaneous identities) -> q-suppressed locus density (Schwartz-Zippel) -> O(1)-per-circuit pricing (deficiency-1 Cramer/eliminant reuse from #199). Assembly: circuits x O(1) <= FM-compatible. Evidence first step: the circuit census's growth rate in n (extends E13's 71-at-n=32 count).
